messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tramadol is used for the management of moderate to moderately severe pain in adults.
This includes postoperative pain.
Postoperative pain is pain after surgery.
Tramadol treats pain severe enough to require opioids.
It may be used as an alternative to other forms of pain relief.
Those other forms did not relieve pain well enough or were not tolerated.
Tramadol extended-release capsules may be used by adults.
The adults require around-the-clock treatment of their moderate to moderately severe chronic pain.
The treatment is for an extended time.
Tramadol should not be used in children younger than 12 years old.
It should not be used in anyone younger than 18 years old with other risk factors, such as breathing problems.
It should not be used in anyone who has recently had surgery to remove their tonsils or adenoids.
Extended-release tramadol (Ultram ER) should not be given to anyone younger than 18 years.
Triplet: ["Tramadol", "used as alternative to", "other forms of pain relief"]

The relation 'used as alternative to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used as an alternative to the treatment or method specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
